property_summary: For all callers addr and target newOwner, only the current owner may successfully call transferOwnership and after a successful call owner() == newOwner; the mutant inverts the onlyOwner check allowing non-owners to call transferOwnership, so there exist caller/newOwner pairs where owner() differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Invert onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT the owner, changing which callers can call transferOwnership and thus who becomes owner after call.
